question: Who was the baby in ghost busters 2?
text: The baby in *Ghostbusters II* (1989) was **Oscar Barrett**, Dana Barrett’s son. Identical twins **William “Will” Deutschendorf** and **Henry “Hank” Deutschendorf II** shared the role. ([catalog.afi.com](https://catalog.afi.com/Film/67913-GHOSTBUSTERS-II?utm_source=openai))
